summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K reporting positive Phase III ARTEMIS-008 data for Ris-Rez (risvutatug rezetecan), a B7-H3 ADC licensed from Hansoh, in relapsed small cell lung cancer in China. Ris-Rez cut death risk 54% versus topotecan (HR 0.46; 95% CI 0.35-0.62; p 0.0001), with median overall survival 18.5 vs 10.3 months across 461 patients after 12.2 months' median follow-up. GSK holds ex-China rights; EMBOLD SCLC-301 pivotal data are expected next year. No transaction, terms, or special-situation event is present.
